head.title: Parking rules
head.description: One national source per country, and optionally a source of its own per municipality. Visitors always see one link: the municipality's when it has one, otherwise the national one.

national.title: National sources
national.description: The fallback for every municipality without a source of its own.
national.empty: There are no countries with municipalities yet.
national.missing: No national source, visitors see "Not known".

municipal.title: Municipal sources
municipal.description: Municipalities with a page of their own; it takes precedence over the national source.
municipal.coverage_one: {{count}} of the {{total}} municipalities in {{country}} has a source of its own.
municipal.coverage_other: {{count}} of the {{total}} municipalities in {{country}} have a source of their own.
municipal.empty: No municipalities with a source of their own yet.

sheet.description: A link to the official page of the government itself. NIPKaart does not copy its content.

edit.title: Edit source
edit.country: The national source for {{name}}. You only change the page it points to.
edit.municipality: The source of the municipality of {{name}}. You only change the page it points to.

scope.label: Applies to
scope.municipality_hint: Takes precedence over the national source

sheet.municipality_hint: Only municipalities without a source of their own.
sheet.url_hint: Starts with https:// and points to the site of the municipality or the government.

confirm.title: Delete source?
confirm.country: Visitors in {{name}} then see "Not known", except in municipalities with a source of their own.
confirm.municipality: Visitors in {{name}} then see the national source.

health.summary_one: {{count}} source does not open. Visitors land on an error page; check the address.
health.summary_other: {{count}} sources do not open. Visitors land on an error page; check the addresses.
